subject: Lumenix pilot: proposed payment framework and one-off no-PO governance
messages:
From: Asha Nair <asha@lumenix.io>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.inference, laura_bennett@redwood.inference
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot onboarding + invoice routing question

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to start a 6-week pilot (low monthly spend, estimated $3.5k total) next month. Our procurement needs a clear payment path: they normally insist on a PO but can make exceptions for small pilots if there's an approved one-off process.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept invoice-only billing for a 6-week pilot and what evidence or approvals you require for that exception? We can complete onboarding forms quickly.

Attached: lumenix_onboarding_form.pdf (basic intake).

Best,
Asha Nair
Head of Platform Partnerships
Lumenix, Inc.

--
Attachment: lumenix_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF, 142KB)

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference
To: Asha Nair <asha@lumenix.io>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.inference, laura_bennett@redwood.inference
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 17:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding + invoice routing question

Asha —

Thanks for sending the intake. We can likely route this as invoice-only for the pilot but need to run it through our temporary exception process. To be efficient, here's what I need from your side:

1) Signed onboarding form (the one you attached is perfect)
2) PO-exception rationale (one paragraph) stating the pilot goal + expected spend (~$3.5k)
3) Primary bill-to contact and an email we can use for invoice remittance

Internal process: I will submit to Finance for a temporary "pilot invoice" exemption. The usual guardrails our finance team asks for are: a spend threshold (< $5k), a completed vendor W-9 or equivalent (if US), and an agreed end date for the pilot so we can close the exception at termination. I've copied Priyo and Laura for approvals and to flag any additional gating items.

If Finance greenlights, we route invoices to billing@redwood.inference and mark the vendor allowlist with a 45-day temporary invoice-only flag. That typically takes 48–72 hours once approved.

I'll draft a concise exception request and circulate internally today.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: proposed_no_po_heuristics.xlsx (Excel, 28KB)

From: priyom_das@redwood.inference
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference, laura_bennett@redwood.inference
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot onboarding + invoice routing question

Vanessa / Laura —

Quick review from Finance: we are comfortable approving an invoice-only exception for Lumenix under three explicit conditions:

- Spend cap not to exceed $5,000 for the pilot period (we need the estimate in the exception form)
- Vendor remittance and tax docs (W-9 or local equivalent) on file before the first invoice is paid
- Clear termination date and requirement that vendor invoices are net-30 with purchase detail matching the onboarding form

I'll add an operational note: set the allowlist entry to auto-expire 60 days after pilot end so we don't have lingering exceptions. Also request legal to confirm the master services agreement (if they sign one) covers pilot liabilities; if not, request a one-page SOW for the pilot.

I'll approve the exception once Vanessa attaches the final onboarding form and Lumenix's W-9. Laura — can you confirm we have the SOW template ready if needed?

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.inference
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference, priyom_das@redwood.inference, Asha Nair <asha@lumenix.io>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding + invoice routing question

Asha / Vanessa —

Confirming next steps and approvals:

- Lumenix to return the signed onboarding form and provide a W-9 by end of day Friday.
- Vanessa will paste a one-paragraph exception rationale into the HubSpot record (HS-34219) and attach the docs.
- Finance (Priyom) has pre-approved conditional allowance with the $5k cap and auto-expiry.
- Legal will not require a master contract for a small pilot; please sign the standard pilot SOW (attached).

Asha — attaching the pilot SOW for signature. Once returned, we will set the vendor to invoice-only allowlist and confirm billing routing. Expect the vendor allowlist entry and billing route to be active within 72 hours of receiving signed SOW + W-9 + final form.

Vanessa — please update the HubSpot link and mark the record as "onboarding docs received" when you upload.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the pilot.

Laura Bennett
